name: btn: New Payment
purpose: Button on the invoice: refuses with a dialog when the invoice has no customer ('You can't add a Payment to a invoice that doesn't have a customer'), otherwise passes the customer id, invoice id and balance to New Payment API { params } and refreshes the window.
open_question: The no-customer rule is enforced only in this button; the target must enforce it on the payment operation. Script 276 (New Payment API) is outside this share.

name: btn: Apply Retainer
purpose: Button on the invoice meant to apply a retainer: stores the invoice id, closes the popover, commits, and calls a script in karbon_kontroller with the invoice id.
calls: karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/328 (step 7, data source karbon_kontroller; script is missing in the source)
open_question: The called script (id 328 in karbon_kontroller) no longer exists in the source (ref=missing), so the button does nothing on the server side and what 'apply retainer' did is unknown. Confirm whether the feature is live; the Invoice layout still references this button.

name: btn: Go To Payment
purpose: Button on an invoice payment line: starts a 0.5 second timer that runs Close Popover After, and opens the related payment on the Card - New Payment layout in a new card window named Payment.
open_question: Timer target 281 (Close Popover After) is outside this share.

name: Block Payment Commit
purpose: Commit guard used as a record-commit trigger on the New Payment card: returns 1 (allow) only when the session flag $$allow_commit is set, and clears the flag; otherwise returns 0 and the commit is blocked.
open_question: Referenced by name from the Card - New Payment layout (and the LedgerLink New Payment Card); some other script must set $$allow_commit before a legitimate save. Direct commits are blocked, so the target must create payments only through its payment operation. The setter is not in this object.

name: btn Cancel Payment
purpose: Cancel button of the New Payment card: reverts the uncommitted payment record without a dialog and closes the card window.

name: btn: Choose Open Invoice
purpose: Handler for choosing an open invoice on the New Payment card: closes the popover, moves to the last payment line and fills it with the chosen invoice id, the payment's customer id and the invoice balance as the amount.
writes:
Payment_PaymentLine::id_Invoice#7 (step 10, portal row (last row, step 9))
Payment_PaymentLine::id_Customer#15 (step 11, portal row (last row, step 9))
Payment_PaymentLine::amount#4 (step 12, portal row (last row, step 9))
open_question: Changes stay uncommitted until Save Payment; the commit guard (Block Payment Commit) applies. The allocation amount defaults to the full invoice balance.

name: Close Popover After
purpose: Timer target: cancels the timer that called it and closes the popover.
open_question: Installed by btn: Go To Payment (script 277).

name: btn Save Payment
purpose: Save button of the New Payment card. It refuses when the total of the payment lines is greater than the payment amount, otherwise sets the commit-allowed flag, commits the payment and its lines, closes the card and immediately sends the payment to QuickBooks Online through Send FMData To QBO in karbon_LedgerLink. If the send fails it shows 'Payment was not sent!' with the error.
writes: commit: Payment and its Payment_PaymentLine rows (Commit Records/Requests step 11, current record)
open_question: The total is built as text such as '10+20' (step 1) and compared through GetAsNumber (step 2) with no Evaluate, so with two or more lines the check may not compare the sum; confirm against the original behaviour. The payment is already committed when the QBO send fails. The send script (302 in karbon_LedgerLink) is outside this share. $$allow_commit is the flag read by Block Payment Commit (script 278).
